name: Palace Guards
headerMeta: Heroic era · Melee infantry · shields · 230 leadership · T4M
pitch: A shield-line brawler built around Guard the Front, a charge-counter gimmick that only pays off once fully mastered — skip the mastery and the unit "doesn't exist." It's not a pike unit either: holding brace instead of cycling it wastes the whole unit's damage.

doctrines.name: Anti-Infantry Doctrine V
doctrines.note: block matters more here than any defense stat

doctrines.name: Siege Fighter Doctrine
doctrines.note: fallback substitute for the all-damage-type pick

battleRole.positioning: Cycle brace and unbrace rather than holding it — this is not a damage-soak unit, and sitting braced only lets a few reaching models fight while the rest stand idle. {2} Only hold brace continuously when defending while outnumbered or engaging too early, and only to refresh crowd-control immunity, not to brawl. {1}
battleRole.tips: Engagement loop: charge in (hero assists), brace on impact, unbrace, brawl, repeat once the brace cooldown clears. {1} Counter-engagement: brace ahead of an incoming charge, unbrace once it lands and continue the brawl, use your hero to disrupt the charge. {1} A time-saving variant — push to fix distance then brace before the full cycle — only holds up if the unit won't take heavy incidental damage while walking unbraced. {1} Unit Mastery is treated as a hard prerequisite: without it, skip the unit entirely. {1}

cards.name: Yendao
cards.why: bypasses Guard the Front — still wrecks your unit

cards.name: Silahdars
cards.why: trails Palace Guards as an escort, striking the clumped-up retaliators after it engages

matchups.pressure: You pressure: Wuwei Mansion Guards — a decisively winnable matchup if played correctly (not just a costly trade), and the margin survives an early or imperfect unbrace.

controls.notes: Charge-type attacks, including charge cavalry, pass through Guard the Front for **zero damage** — but this is not blanket anti-cavalry; non-charge cavalry ignores it. {1} Unbracing isn't just for brawling — it also **refreshes crowd-control immunity** for the next brace cycle. {1} Don't sit permanently braced vs Wuwei Mansion Guards: stack up, brace before their sweep ability lands, then unbrace for full-unit damage. {2}
